proposal.summary: The message is a routine password reset request from an employee, not a security vulnerability report.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Assist the user via the standard account recovery process (verify identity, unlock account, reset password) and remind about secure password practices.

evidence_quotes.claim: Message content shows a support request for password reset, not a vulnerability report.
evidence_quotes.quote: Hi IT, I forgot my password again and now my account is locked after too many attempts. Can you reset it so I can get into the timesheet system before payroll closes today? My employee ID is in my signature. Thanks!
